simple.meaning: מַשְׁקוֹף (mashqôwph) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a lintel.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 12:7. The surrounding context includes blood, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַשְׁקוֹף (H4947) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מַשְׁקוֹף (mashqôwph) / H4947 is traced through Exodus 12:7, Exodus 12:22, Exodus 12:23 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.rootNote: from 8259 in its original sense of overhanging;

occurrences.englishText: They shall take some of the blood, and put it on the two door posts and on the lintel, on the houses in which they shall eat it.

You shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two door posts with the blood that is in the basin. None of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.

For Yahweh will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the lintel, and on the two door posts, Yahweh will pass over the door, and will not allow the destroyer to come in to your houses to strike you.
